description: This file defines a set of interface classes for expression and command handling within a calculator or expression evaluation module. It includes interfaces for different command types such as operator, unary, binary, operand, and parenthesis commands, along with methods for command manipulation and visitor acceptance.

classes.name: IExpressionCommand
classes.description: Base interface for all expression commands, providing methods to get command type and accept visitors.

classes.name: IOperatorCommand
classes.description: Interface for operator commands, extending IExpressionCommand with method to set command.

classes.name: IUnaryCommand
classes.description: Interface for unary operator commands, extending IOperatorCommand with methods to get and set commands.

classes.name: IBinaryCommand
classes.description: Interface for binary operator commands, extending IOperatorCommand with methods to get and set commands.

classes.name: IOpndCommand
classes.description: Interface for operand commands, providing methods for command list management, sign toggling, token retrieval, and command setting.

classes.name: IParenthesisCommand
classes.description: Interface for parenthesis commands, extending IExpressionCommand with method to get command.

methods.name: GetCommandType
methods.description: Returns the type of command, as defined in CalculationManager::CommandType.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor implementing ISerializeCommandVisitor for serialization or processing.

methods.name: SetCommand
methods.description: Sets the command value for operator and parenthesis commands.

methods.name: GetCommands
methods.description: Retrieves the list of commands for operand and unary commands.

methods.name: SetCommands
methods.description: Sets the list of commands for operand and unary commands.

methods.name: AppendCommand
methods.description: Appends a command to the operand command list.

methods.name: ToggleSign
methods.description: Toggles the sign of the operand.

methods.name: RemoveFromEnd
methods.description: Removes the last command from the operand command list.

methods.name: IsNegative
methods.description: Checks if the operand is negative.

methods.name: IsSciFmt
methods.description: Checks if the operand is in scientific format.

methods.name: IsDecimalPresent
methods.description: Checks if a decimal point is present in the operand.

methods.name: GetToken
methods.description: Retrieves the token string representation of the operand, considering the decimal symbol.

methods.name: GetCommand
methods.description: Retrieves the command value for parenthesis commands.
